tool.description: The tool Gentry was set up for, such as claude.

dir.description: Directory of the integration files built for the tool.

plugin_version.description: Version of the built plugin; it changes whenever the plugin content does.

action.description: What happened in the tool: installed, updated, unchanged or switched (the plugin was served from another directory, see previous_dir). The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.

previous_dir.description: Directory the tool served the plugin from before it was switched to dir; only with the action switched.

enabled.description: Whether the plugin is enabled in the tool; Gentry does not enable a plugin the operator disabled.

permission.description: The rule that allows the tools of Gentry in the user settings of the tool: added, present (the settings had it), failed (the settings cannot be read) or unwritten (the settings cannot be written); with failed and unwritten the settings are left as they are. The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.

settings.description: The file of the user settings of the tool: of Claude Code, the rule is in it; of Codex, the settings Gentry checked and changed.

hook_trust.description: Codex only: the trust of the session start hook of Gentry in Codex: trusted (Gentry trusted it now), present (Codex trusted it already), untrusted (Gentry could not trust it, see hook_error), skipped (the administrator turned the hooks off), failed (the settings of the hooks cannot be read) or unwritten (the settings of the hooks cannot be written); with failed and unwritten the hook is not written and the settings of the hooks are left as they are. The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.

hook_error.description: Codex only: why Gentry could not trust the hook, as Codex said it; only with hook_trust untrusted.

hooks_file.description: Codex only: the file of the settings of the hooks of Codex the hook of Gentry is in.

hooks_feature.description: Codex only: whether the hooks of Codex are on: on (the settings leave them on), enabled (the operator turned them off, Gentry turned them on) or managed_off (the administrator turned them off: Gentry does not turn them on). The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.

sandbox.description: Codex only: the data root in the sandbox of Codex: added (opened for writing now), present (open already) or profile (a profile of permissions sets the sandbox: it is left as it is, and the data root is not open). The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.

worktrees_trusted.description: Codex only, and always with Codex: the worktrees of the pools whose trust in Codex this command wrote, by the record of the root of their main repository; in no order.

worktrees_distrusted.description: Codex only, and always with Codex: the worktrees of the pools whose record of trust in Codex the operator set other than trusted: they are left as they are; in no order.
